model.name: serviceWorker.networkFirstShell
model.description: The SW fetch handler serves the app SHELL (index.html/navigations) + bundles NETWORK-FIRST (ServiceWorker.navigationStrategy): fetch fresh, fall back to cache ONLY when offline - so a deploy's new shell reaches the running client without a hard-reload (the prior cache-first shell defeated pollForWorkerUpdate+claimClients). Offline intact by construction via the cache-fallback.
